info.title: easyocrsharp 3.1.0 — OCR powered by EasyOcrSharp
info.description: Command-line OCR powered by EasyOcrSharp — EasyOCR's neural models on ONNX Runtime, no Python required. Scans images, PDFs, globs and folders to text, JSON, hOCR, ALTO or TSV, writes searchable PDFs, and pre-pulls models for air-gapped deployment.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: (EasyOCR's neural models on ONNX Runtime; library 3.1.0).

commands.name: models
commands.description: Pull, list and locate the ONNX models (air-gapped deployment).

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Write a searchable PDF from a scanned one.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path of the searchable PDF to write (required).

options.name: --lang
options.description: Language codes to recognize, comma-separated (default: en). Repeatable.

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Rasterization resolution for PDF input, 36-1200 (default: 200).

options.name: --jpeg-quality
options.description: JPEG quality of the embedded page images, 1-100 (default: 75).

options.name: --paragraph
options.description: Merge lines into paragraph blocks before building the text layer.

options.name: --line
options.description: Merge boxes into lines (the default).

options.name: --word
options.description: Do not merge: one text-layer entry per detected box.

options.name: --preprocess
options.description: Comma-separated clean-up: deskew,binarize,denoise,sharpen,orientation,unwarp,rotate. Repeatable.

options.name: --allowlist
options.description: Only ever emit these characters (e.g. 0123456789). Sharpens constrained fields.

options.name: --blocklist
options.description: Never emit these characters. Ignored when --allowlist is set.

options.name: --min-confidence
options.description: Drop recognized lines below this confidence, 0-1 (default: 0, keep all).

options.name: --decoder
options.description: CTC decoder: greedy (default), beam, wordbeam.

options.name: --beam-width
options.description: Beam width for --decoder beam/wordbeam (default: 5).

options.name: --gpu
options.description: Force the CUDA execution provider (needs the EasyOcrSharp.Gpu package). Default: auto-detect.

options.name: --cpu
options.description: Force CPU execution even when an accelerator is available.

options.name: --cache
options.description: Model cache directory (default: $EASYOCRSHARP_CACHE or the per-user cache).

options.name: --offline
options.description: Never download: a model missing from the cache is a hard error (air-gapped hosts).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress progress and informational output on stderr. Errors are still reported.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help text and exit.
The text layer is written with the standard Latin-1 encoding, so non-Latin scripts may not be selectable in every reader even though recognition itself is unaffected.
